provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Found by the part A check, which downloaded it at 13:08:37Z (plain and with a cache-busting query) and again at 13:39:45Z on 25 September 2026, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 14:19:04Z and 14:55:36Z, 36 minutes apart, and at 14:57:30Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第3号 (1994-10-13), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/113105261X00319941013. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office.

visual_review.method: Machine-readable minute text read in full for the cited speeches and the surrounding questions; the printed page images were not viewed.

rows.text: Asked on 13 October 1994 by 松本善明 whether, as LDP president (自民党総裁として), he stood by the LDP statement that the questioner dated 昨年十二月十四日, 河野 (printed ○河野国務大臣) answered that at that time he had issued the president's statement just read out (あの当時、私は今お読みになった総裁声明を出しました).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
